title: Heat top-up technology
question: Which technology lifts heat to the 100 degC supply?

options.label: Plate HEX + HTHP in series + CHP + peak boiler (C2/C3)
options.notes: candidates: C2-2d, C3-2d, C6-2d, C7-2d, C8-3d; top-ranked (LCOH ranking)

options.label: Deeper wells, direct plate HEX + small peak boiler (C4)
options.notes: candidates: none; excluded by DesignGuard/verifier: C4-2d

choice_label: Plate HEX + HTHP in series + CHP + peak boiler (C2/C3)

criterion.text: lowest lcoh_per_mwh + lcoc_per_mwh among guard-passed candidates without unmet demand in economics

rationale: Selected because it achieved the lowest lcoh_per_mwh among guard-passed options in economics as evidenced by TR-013. gas-boiler-chp-topup was rejected for higher lcoh_per_mwh. deeper-direct-hex was rejected due to eligibility status. shallow-large-hp was rejected for higher lcoh_per_mwh.
